limitations: Adversarial pass run because the diff touches authorization (permission and resource checks), tenant isolation (tenant-scoped customer lookup) and concurrency (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE lock choice); the implementer listed none. Hypotheses H1 lock wiring, H2 authorization order, H3 tenant source, H4 null-id/evaluation order, H5 not-found exception type were all cleared by C2 with base control C3; only H1 has a negative control (C4), H2-H5 probes were not negative-controlled.
C2-C4 use Mockito stand-ins; real locking and RLS are covered only by the existing integration and system tests in C1.
Per benchmark constraints the full ./gradlew test/check/build was not run; only filtered purchase tests and the probe. The implementer's compileJava claim is subsumed by C1 compiling the candidate.
Probe source kept at runs/K3-pilot/probes/H1-H5/; no test was added to the candidate, which is acceptable for a pure refactor.
